aggregation_reference: Current shared manuscript scoring revision, 2026-09-16; Text IoU omission explicitly approved by owner.
chamfer_policy: Clamp each case to [0,0.01], use 0.01 for invalid, then average; score = 1 - CD / 0.01.
cost_policy: Saved standard-rate generation cost divided by 400 selected responses (100 UIDs x two specifications x two formats). USD/generation is an average for one response; retries, Judge and local evaluation are excluded. Full-task totals and token usage are unchanged; Kimi retains its tokenizer estimate.
dataset_graphs: Keep complete dataset diagrams and statistics unchanged; the distribution files here describe only the evaluation subset.
geometry_aggregation: Average available normalized geometry terms within each valid case, then average all 100 case scores. Invalid cases contribute zero.
invalid_policy: Retain selected original outcomes and fixed denominator; do not infer a new failure taxonomy.
iou_aggregation: Omit unavailable IoU for valid cases; preserve measured zeros and invalid zero penalties in the reported IoU mean.
per_case_policy: Geometry omits unavailable IoU only within that valid case. Cases stay in the fixed100 denominator. F@.05 is diagnostic only.
selection: ordered first 100 UIDs of the existing ranked Text400 list; no new sampling
text_score: 100 * mean(descriptive Judge, parametric Geometry, parametric Judge); Topology reported separately.
